## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional commit messages
- [ ] Tests added or updated (and the e2e lane, if host or remote behavior changed)
- [ ] `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Changeset added for changes to a published package
- [ ] Docs updated (package READMEs, `docs/`, error pages) where behavior changed
- [ ] No Next.js internals used
